steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password text exactly as given, do not modify or spell it out. Then confirm you are signed in as admin and report what indicates that.

02-open: Go to the repository bench/bench-repo at http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo and open its Issues list. Filter to OPEN issues only. Report the exact titles of every open issue whose title starts with 'Seed:' exactly as displayed, one per line, with their issue numbers. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo at http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo, create a NEW issue with the title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench issue for run {{runid}}'). Submit it and report the new issue's number as displayed (Gitea shows it as #<number>) and its title. Do not touch any existing issues.

04-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), set the issue's labels to exactly 'bug' and 'priority-high' using the Labels picker in the issue's sidebar. Make sure the app has applied them so the sidebar shows both labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' on the issue (not merely ticked in the open menu). Report exactly which labels are displayed on the issue page sidebar when done.

05-open: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee' using the Assignees picker in the issue's sidebar. Make sure the app has applied it so the sidebar shows 'bench-assignee' as the assignee on the issue (not merely ticked in the open menu). Report exactly what the sidebar shows for Assignees when done.

06-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone' using the Milestone picker in the issue's sidebar. Make sure the app has applied it so the sidebar shows 'Bench Milestone' as the milestone on the issue (not merely ticked in the open menu). Report exactly what the sidebar shows for Milestone when done, and confirm the labels (bug, priority-high) and assignee (bench-assignee) are still present.

07-add: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}') using the markdown comment text area, and submit it. Verify the comment appears on the issue page with its text visible, and report the comment text as displayed. Also confirm the issue still shows labels bug and priority-high, assignee bench-assignee, and milestone Bench Milestone.

08-open: Read-only verification, do not modify anything. Open {{03-create.url}} and report: (a) the issue title and number exactly as displayed in the heading, (b) whether the issue description/body text contains '{{runid}}' and quote the body text, (c) the exact list of labels shown in the sidebar, (d) the assignee shown in the sidebar, (e) the milestone shown in the sidebar, (f) whether there is a comment whose text contains '{{runid}}' and quote it. Then open the repo's open issues list and report the titles of all open issues starting with 'Seed:' to confirm they are unchanged.
